title: Assimp through 6.0.6 Heap Out-of-Bounds Read via MD2 Importer frameSize
description: CVE-2026-129480 is a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in Assimp through version 6.0.6 related to the MD2 importer component, specifically involving the frameSize parameter. This flaw can lead to reading memory beyond the allocated buffer, potentially causing application crashes or information disclosure.
